sn29.21-50:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn29.21-50:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Jalābujānaṃ nāgānam || pa ||
sn29.21-50:2.1: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī ||
sn29.21-50:2.3: Opapātīkā nāgā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || 5
sn29.21-50:2.5: Ahovatāham kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyyan ti || 6
sn29.21-50:2.10: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā opapatikānam nāgānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppapajjatīti || || Evam
sn29.21-50:3.2: Evaṃ catusu yonisu cattārīsa veyyākaraṇāni kātabbāni || || Dasa suttantā honti
